repository.name: @webex/helper-image
repository.purpose: A Webex JavaScript SDK helper package that reads EXIF orientation onto image files, resolves their MIME type, and measures and thumbnails them through separate Node and browser implementations.

commands.compile: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- no standalone compile step exists: the sources are JavaScript transpiled by Babel as part of build:src, and package.json declares no typecheck or compile-only target.

unit.framework: Mocha with chai assertions via @webex/test-helper-chai and Sinon stubs, executed by @webex/legacy-tools. The same spec directory also runs under Karma in a real browser through the browser-test command, which is the only way the browserOnly cases in test/unit/spec/index.js execute; Chrome and Firefox are that runner's defaults and it also needs the fixture server that serves the test image. There is no separate integration or end-to-end suite in this package.

modules.coverage_evidence: Canonical spec generated from the complete committed source and its unit suite. The public surface, dual-runtime split, invariants and failure modes are backed by file evidence. No characterization baseline exists yet: the only suite is test/unit/spec/index.js, whose readExifData cases are disabled with xdescribe, so the EXIF parsing path is unpinned and a characterization baseline is required before risky modification.

helper-image-package-api.summary: Published package export surface. package.json declares the entry points (main, devMain) and the browser field that substitutes the browser implementation of processImage; src/index.js declares the four exported functions updateImageOrientation, readExifData, processImage and detectFileType. The package ships no .d.ts or API report, so these two declarations together are the ecosystem-native contract.

image-thumbnail-png.summary: The [thumbnail, fileDimensions, thumbnailDimensions] triple returned by processImage, whose thumbnail is PNG-encoded in both runtimes and whose orientation semantics follow EXIF values 1 through 8.

http-core-detect.summary: Magic-byte MIME sniffing used by detectFileType when a file carries neither type nor mimeType. Runs locally with no network call and rejects anything that is not a Blob, ArrayBuffer or Uint8Array.

exifr-parse.summary: EXIF tag reader used by readExifData to obtain Orientation, ExifImageHeight and ExifImageWidth from JPEG bytes.

graphicsmagick-cli.source: gm npm package invoking the host GraphicsMagick or ImageMagick binary
graphicsmagick-cli.summary: Host image toolchain the Node implementation shells out to for size measurement and thumbnail generation. Its absence is detected through an EPIPE error string and degrades to an undefined result rather than a rejection.

browser-image-apis.source: DOM platform APIs: FileReader, Blob, URL.createObjectURL, Image, HTMLCanvasElement, atob
browser-image-apis.summary: Browser platform surface the browser implementation and updateImageOrientation depend on for byte reading, decoding, canvas rasterization and base64 conversion.

spec_sources.notes: Consumer-facing npm README in standard-readme form. Left byte-for-byte unchanged under keep-separate and used as context only. It documents updateImageOrientation, readExifData and orient, omits processImage and detectFileType, and presents the module-internal orient as if it were a package export; the canonical module spec states the real boundary.

module_docs_decision.reason: The package holds no module-local documentation folder or competing docs convention, so the source-local default resolves without collision: the single module at src/ takes src/docs/README.md.

repo_context_decision.reason: Neither target exists in the package. The schemas/ directory is present but empty, so both the context and its schema are created from the Repo Standards snapshot rather than reused.
